name: @zebra-design-system/patterns
note: Generated when the patterns are packaged. Do not edit: change the .md files and package again.

organisms.name: Dialog
organisms.job: Asks for one decision that must happen now, or a short task of a few inputs, and blocks the screen until it's answered.

slots.holds: the decision; for a confirmation, a question about this specific action
what the person needs in order to decide: the object, the consequence, and whether it can be undone
the few inputs of a short task
the object's name or a stated word, typed to confirm
slots.condition: the action is among the most dangerous

slots.holds: Cancel beside an action it would call off; otherwise Close, or what happens next
the confirm, repeating the action's verb, and at most one other outcome of the same decision, at the bottom in the product's button order

organisms.name: Sheet
organisms.job: Holds short, contextual choices or details, anchored to the bottom edge.

slots.holds: a Close at its top
the choices or details, opened to their own height, up to about half the screen
Apply, which puts the choices into effect together
slots.condition: it holds choices that apply together, such as filters

organisms.name: Side panel
organisms.job: Opens from the trailing edge for detail or editing that needs the page behind it visible.

slots.holds: the panel's title, which is also its name
a close control at the trailing end of its header
tabs for parallel views of one object
the detail or the task; it scrolls while the header and footer stay put
the actions that finish what it edits

organisms.name: Toast
organisms.job: Confirms something the person just did, briefly, at the bottom of the content area.

slots.holds: what just happened, as the action and the object in the simple past, in one line, two at most on a handheld
one action named by a single verb, such as Undo or View, that is never the only way to do it

organisms.name: Notice
organisms.job: A message about one page, section or element, at its top, that stays until it's resolved.

slots.holds: the severity's icon and word, with its colour as support
what happened, then what to do
the one next step that fixes the problem or works around it
slots.condition: it's an error or a warning

slots.holds: a way to dismiss it

organisms.name: System banner
organisms.job: A message about a condition that affects the whole product, across the content area directly below the header.

slots.holds: the severity's icon and word, with its colour as support
the condition, what still works, and what happens to the person's work
the one next step that fixes the problem or works around it
slots.condition: it's an error or a warning

slots.holds: a way to dismiss it; it returns while the condition remains

organisms.name: Menu
organisms.job: A short list of actions or options, opened next to the control that opened it.

slots.holds: fewer than about ten, the most used first, nearest where it opens, grouped by dividers
a check on each item that can be chosen
the keyboard shortcut beside its command
destructive actions, last, after a divider

organisms.name: Error summary
organisms.job: Lists every error that stopped a form being submitted, at the top of the form, and takes focus.

slots.holds: one per error, naming the field in the words of its error and linking to it

spacing.between: an icon and its label; a label and its field
items in one group: fields in a section, rows of facts, buttons in a group
a heading and the content it heads
a container's edge and its content
cards or tiles side by side
the page's edge and its content

spacing.tight: `--space-2xs` under a label, `--space-xs` beside an icon. Inside a component, its own gap.
spacing.related: `--space-sm`, or `--space-md` between fields and between rows that are targets
spacing.heading: `--space-sm`
spacing.inset: `--space-lg`, or `--space-md` at compact width. Never less than `--space-card`.
spacing.page: `--space-page`. The size mode on the root changes its value with width.

organisms.side-panel: No component yet. Report it as a gap.
organisms.menu: Dropdown with Dropdown Menu and Menu Item
organisms.error-summary: No component. Compose it from Inline Banner with `status="negative"`, holding one link per field.
